name: PT Supreme Cable Manufacturing & Commerce Tbk (SUCACO)
description: Indonesian cable manufacturer (established 1970, listed as PT SUCACO Tbk, brand SUPREME) producing power cables up to 150 kV with XLPE insulation via triple extrusion and dry curing; a founding member of the Indonesian cable manufacturers association APKABEL. Medium-voltage types include N2XSY and NA2XSY to IEC 60502-2, SNI and PLN specification SPLN.
products: fire-resistant, instrumentation, solar and OPGW cable

sources.note: SUCACO product catalogue page (medium-voltage, LV, fire-resistant, instrumentation, solar, OPGW cable families), read 2026-11-13; XLPE triple-extrusion dry-curing, 150 kV capability and IEC 60502-2/SNI/SPLN standards from company literature cited in search summary
